Geo Hierarchy Code.note: dx-select-box; no '*' marker shown on the label (mandatory per business page). Click #geoCode, then the dx-list-item-content. Entries are code-name, not only geo level 2 names.

Distributor.note: dx-tag-box (multi-select, class fixed-height-tagbox). Lists by distributor NAME only (no code). For HQ on org 010104 / distributor 15108843 the list showed only 'Auto KARACHI'; 15108843-IBRAHIM TRADERS never appeared under any of the 9 geos (list loads slowly: wait ~2 s after picking a geo).

Download Excel.note: Enabled before any filter is chosen. With geo + distributor chosen: downloads VehicleMasterModification.xlsx (4 KB, header row only) and shows toast 'File downloaded successfully'.

Upload Excel.note: Button (not an input) id fileInput; enabled before any filter is chosen. NOT pressed in the read-only look.

messages.when: after Download Excel with geo + distributor selected

lessons.text: Direct URL /ngui/excel-upload/vehicle-master-modification redirects to /ngui/content-master/menu; open the screen from the menu (hamburger #menurollin > Search Here > li#VEHICLE_MASTER_MODIFICATION).

Headquarter menu shows ONE vehicle bulk option, 'Vehicle Master Bulk Upload' (li#VEHICLE_MASTER_MODIFICATION, route vehicle-master-modification). i18n has vehicle_master_creation = 'Vehicle Master Creation' but no such menu entry for headquarter on cnr1dev1.

Template 'Excel Template' sheet, ONE row (headers only), 39 columns, 17 marked '*': Distributor Code*, Description*, Status*, Model Name*, Registration Number*, Model ID*, Vehicle Dimensions (L,W,H) Cubic Meters*, Allow multi trips*, Vehicle Model Description (...)*, Mileage*, Fleet Type (CAPTIVE/THIRD_PARTY/ADHOC)*, Unit of Volume (METERS_CUBIC)*, Min Volume*, Max Volume*, Unit of Weight (KG)*, Min Weight*, Max Weight*. Other columns: Code, Vehicle Color, Chassis Number, Engine Number, Manufacturing Year, Owner NID, Owner Name, Meter Reading Type, Fuel Type, Vehicle Type, Unloading Side (REAR/TOP/LEFT/RIGHT), Deep Freezer (Y/N), Cold Chain: (Y/N), User Count, Average Rate, Limit Multi Trip, Min/Max GSV, Min/Max NIV, Min/Max TIV. No data validations, no hidden lists, no data rows: allowed values exist only in header text.
Both filters visible; neither label carries a '*'. Download Excel and Upload Excel are enabled with no filter selected.

differences.what: Business page/story expect a Creation and a Modification screen; headquarter on cnr1dev1 sees only 'Vehicle Master Bulk Upload'. The downloaded file is named VehicleMasterModification.xlsx and is empty (no existing vehicles).
differences.note: Whether this one screen serves both creation and modification, or Creation is a separate option not granted to role 0014, needs a person.
